That's the kind of experience we're talking about with this particular belief about self-discipline, and you've already had such an experience, so you've shown that it's possible. When you feel your willpower and motivation fading, remind yourself of those previous experiences and imagine the same happening now.
zh: 本段将第三段的 mindset theory 转化为可操作的 self-reminder technique，帮助尚未接受 self-discipline can feed itself 这一 belief 的读者用个人经历建立新的信念，而不是宣称这些经历客观证明自律会增强。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: What if your experiences have always seemed to indicate that your self-control diminishes with use, and you need breaks to recharge? There's nothing wrong with that as long as you can afford to take those breaks. If not, remind yourself that not everyone experiences self-discipline as a depletable resource and that your experience might be different if you focus on gathering more energy at this point rather than focusing on how difficult it is to continue or the need for a break.
zh: 本段补充了第四段策略的适用边界，使文章的建议更现实：它承认休息的价值，同时在现实任务不能中断时提供注意力重构的方法。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Also, if you know someone who is a role model of self-discipline, picture that person in your situation, persisting in the task. Regardless of how you do it, as you push forward to continue to accomplish progress, be sure to mentally reinforce yourself by taking pride in your ability to exert more willpower as you persist.
zh: 本段继续扩展实践层面的 strategies，从回忆自身经验转向借助他人形象和自我肯定，进一步帮助读者把增长型 self-discipline mindset 落实到行动中。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: The benefits of exerting willpower are cumulative. Your self-discipline is akin to a muscle, and each time you resist temptation or persist in a task despite a lack of motivation, you strengthen that muscle, leading to less effort and resistance in similar instances in the future.
zh: 本段作为 conclusion 回扣文章主旨，最终确认 self-discipline 并非只能耗尽的有限 resource，而是能在每次 persistence 中逐渐增强的能力。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Imagine you and a stranger are sitting on a couch. How close would you sit to them? It turns out that how much of a buffer zone you prefer may reveal a lot about your personality.
zh: 本段提出全文的 basic question：个人空间偏好是否能反映人的特征。它把日常行为转化为可研究的 social behavior，为后文逐层说明 personality、gender、age、culture 和 attraction 等影响因素建立总入口。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: In one study, researchers sought to ascertain how our personality may be linked to our preferred amount of personal space. The researchers found that people who scored higher in the trait of agreeableness tended to sit closer to others, as did people who were more open and outgoing.
zh: 本段完成了从 general possibility 到 specific evidence 的推进，证明 personal-space preference 确实与 personality 有关。它首先解释文章主旨中的 personality factor，也为后文继续介绍其他 individual differences 提供逻辑起点。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Other individual differences, such as gender and age, can also affect how much personal space we crave. Women tend to prefer more physical distance from strangers or acquaintances and older adults also generally tend to prefer to keep more distance between themselves and others.
zh: 本段进一步拓宽文章的 explanatory framework，说明个人空间不仅与 personality 有关，也受 gender 和 age 等 demographic characteristics 影响。它使文章主旨从单一心理因素发展为 individual differences 的多维解释。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Beyond reflecting our personality and demographics, the amount of personal space we prefer is also linked to our cultural backgrounds. In a study involving participants from 42 countries, researchers found that around the world people's desired amount of personal space varied substantially. For example, in Romania, the average amount of personal space people said they would prefer from a stranger was more than 4 feet, whereas in Argentina it was roughly half that.
zh: 本段把文章从个体层面的 personality、gender 和 age 推向社会文化层面的 cultural background。它说明 social distance 不是普遍相同的行为标准，而会随文化环境发生 substantial variation，从而丰富文章主旨中的 environmental and social factors。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: What might underlie this variation? The researchers looked at a number of potential factors, but the only one that was significantly correlated with preferred interpersonal distance was average temperature. The warmer the place, it seems, the "warmer" the people and the less space they needed between them and others.
zh: 本段解释了 cultural variation 可能由什么因素支撑，补充了文章主旨中的 temperature 变量。它还提醒读者，环境条件能够影响人际距离，但文章证据表达的是 correlation，因此在理解说明文时要保持结论强度与原文一致。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Personal space may also reflect interpersonal attraction. Researchers have found that our chosen physical proximity also appears to reflect how much we like others. The more people would like to be friends with the other person, the closer they sat to them.
zh: 本段以 interpersonal attraction 收束全文，说明个人空间还会随着当下的人际好感而变化。它补全了文章主旨中的 attraction factor，并与前文的 personality、demographics、culture 和 temperature 共同说明 social distance 是多因素共同塑造的行为信号。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: The cost of a mortgage or rents, meeting monthly utility bills, paying for a new car—all headaches most people get to worry about from their 20s. But while some may struggle to pay their bills after a few too many nights out at the start of the month, others will have a tightly followed plan for their repayments. So what is the difference between the shrewd saver and the more reckless spender?
zh: 本段是全文的 opening hook，用成人理财困境制造共鸣，并提出 habits difference 这一待解问题。它为后文“七岁前形成习惯、应尽早教育”的主旨预留了逻辑入口。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Experts believe it is all about the age you learn how to spend responsibly. Adult money habits are typically set by the age of seven, according to a large-scale study by the government's Money Advice Service and behaviour experts at Cambridge University. By then, most children have grasped how to recognise the value of money and are capable of complex functions such as planning ahead, delaying a decision until later and understanding that some choices are irreversible.
zh: 本段给出全文最关键的 research finding，确立早期金融教育的必要性。后文关于父母示范、游戏和学校项目的建议，都以这一 age-seven finding 为依据。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Tomorrow marks the start of Global Money Week, a worldwide initiative to help children make smart financial decisions and learn that "money matters matter". But for many young people in the UK, it's a matter of too little, too late. "The habits of mind which influence the ways children approach complex problems and decisions, including financial ones, are largely determined in the first few years of life," says Dr David Whitebread, the co-author of the study. And this core behaviour is very likely to influence their financial decisions when they are adults, he says.
zh: 本段把科学结论连接到当下的 Global Money Week，使文章既有时效性又有教育立场。它进一步强调早教不是可有可无的补充，而是避免成年错误决策的前提。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: The study also urges parents not to underestimate their own good and bad money habits. "Since young children have few monetary resources they control independently, it is the basic approaches and skills which are modelled, discussed and demonstrated by parents that are likely to be influential levers, breeding efficient habits and practices," it says.
zh: 本段将早期理财教育的责任首先落实到家庭环境。它为下一段讨论父母应主动教什么，以及为何许多父母尚未付诸 practice，完成了自然过渡。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Parents who choose to help their children learn how to plan ahead, reflect on the past and self-regulate can make a huge difference in promoting good financial behaviour in the future, explains Whitebread. According to a survey by M&G Investments, the vast majority (83%) of parents recognise the value of teaching their children about money. However, this concern does not always carry through to practice—one in six do not feel confident enough to do it. More than one in every four parents think children should take responsibility for understanding money themselves.
zh: 本段既说明家庭教育的有效路径，也揭露家长执行不足这一现实障碍。它使全文从“应当早教”的原则，进入“如何帮助家长做到”的实际问题。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: "There's joy in the fact that young children are spontaneous and live life in the moment, unrestrained by adult problems. But teaching children about money when they are young is a good way for parents to help them learn to delay satisfaction, so that the child thinks: 'I'd like to do this but I'm not going to'. Hard evidence suggests, if you want your child to do well in life, the earlier you can start trying to teach them inhibition and self-discipline, the better," says Whitebread, pointing to research that has shown people in prison frequently have poor impulse control, a personality trait that can affect relationships and long-term health.
zh: 本段深化全文主旨，说明儿童理财教育的价值超出会算钱或会存钱。它把 delayed gratification 和 self-discipline 作为成年生活成功的重要基础，增强了早教论点的说服力。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: But how should a parent try to teach their child to spend responsibly? One simple way is to give them pocket money and then help them to analyse and learn from any foolish spending decisions.
zh: 本段开启文章的实践方案部分，把抽象的 responsible spending 转化为家庭中可执行的活动。它也为后续 board games、apps 和银行体验等多种工具建立结构。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Another is through board games which can help teach financial responsibility. Pop to the Shops, a shopping board game for five-to-nine-year-olds, has been one of Orchard Toys' top 10 bestselling board games every year for the past 15 years. To win, players must use fake coins to purchase everyday grocery items from various shops around the board, and give the other players who visit their shop the correct change. If they don't have enough money, they must purchase a cheaper item. "It acts as a conversation starter about money—parents can fill in the gaps," says Orchard Toys product manager Rachael Sutcliffe.
zh: 本段给出一种低门槛、互动性强的家庭教育方式。它具体落实了文章所倡导的 planning 与 responsible choices，并强调父母参与能放大游戏的教育价值。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: There are also some pocket-money-tracking and payment apps, such as RoosterMoney and goHenry, which are designed to be used by under-sevens, and which boast that they can help children develop good money habits. This is dependent on the children receiving enough pocket money to need an app to track their spending, which research suggests is not always the case.
zh: 本段避免文章变成单向推荐，指出数字工具的效果依赖真实家庭条件。它提醒读者，早期金融教育需要真实的 spending context，而不能完全依靠 technology。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Surprisingly, given the research about habit-forming in young children, there are very few gaming apps that can help under-sevens—Pigby's Fair, developed by NatWest, being a notable exception. In this, children who solve basic puzzles will earn virtual money selling what they have made at different stalls in a fair, then spend or save it. But the need to shift virtual money around, and take into account interest payments and pocket money bonuses, makes it a complex financial education tool.
zh: 本段进一步说明可用的数字教育资源存在不足，强化父母和学校不能把早教责任简单外包给 app。它也为下一段转向线上小游戏和线下银行体验提供过渡。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: There are plenty of online games which focus on coin recognition and counting with money, such as the Igloo Shopping game or Top Marks' Coins Game. So what if children find such games boring? An exciting (and free) real-world option for parents to use is a visit to Metro Bank. Although, like most banks, it does not allow children to open an account until they turn 11, it specifically tries to offer young children a chance to learn about money inside its branches by inviting kids to use the "magic money machines" to count their coins. Children who accurately guess how much was in their piggy bank(猪形储钱罐) get a prize, and free candies are handed out when the coins are exchanged for banknotes. The bank does not take a commission from the transaction.
zh: 本段拓宽了教育场景，证明金融学习可以从屏幕走向真实社会环境。通过有奖励的 bank activity，它回应了如何保持儿童兴趣这一实践难题。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: At six years old, my daughter Flora is getting to grips with her finances early. She tested out a number of games aimed at teaching children her age the value of money. She enjoyed them all, but best, in her view, is Money Match Cafe, a board game where she must work out the value of different denominations(面额) of coin in her imaginary restaurant, her "customers" being her stuffed toys. "It was really fun because you get to serve food to your own toys on a little tray with a napkin on it, and then you can hug them," she says.
zh: 本段以儿童真实反应验证游戏化教育的可行性，让文章从宏观研究落到可感知的学习体验。它支持全文“通过 practical activities 教钱”的建议。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: "If you're six and you play this game, you'll learn that you might not have the right amount of money for what you want to buy. You just have to cross your fingers and hope. It's a good challenge, and I enjoyed adding the coins up to see how much they made. But I don't like the name. Money Match Cafe is not a good name for a cafe. I would have liked it more if it had been Flora's Cafe or Fantastically Baked Lunches."
zh: 本段从 Flora 的儿童视角进一步证明，理财游戏能够具体训练数钱和接受预算约束。它也提示教育工具要兼顾 learning challenge 与儿童的兴趣体验。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Seven out of ten teachers think children are now faced with financial decisions earlier. On Wednesday, Lifesavers—a new project which promotes financial education in primary schools—is hosting a conference to encourage teachers to join its programme and get free classroom resources and training. Almost two-thirds of millennials(千禧一代) wish they had received more money advice at a younger age, according to a Santander survey.
zh: 本段把教育责任从家庭扩展到学校，并展示可操作的学校项目。教师对现实需求的判断、学校项目的开展以及成年人的回顾性遗憾，共同支持文章主旨中“parents and schools should teach children”的双主体框架。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Only a third of parents involve their children in discussions about their household finances, even though less than half of young people aged seven to seventeen receive financial education at school, another survey shows.
zh: 本段指出现有早期金融教育的实际覆盖不足，增强全文倡议的紧迫性。它与上一段的学校项目形成对照：虽然已有行动，但总体教育仍远远不够。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Most adults believe their parents have had the biggest influence on their money behaviour. So when should they start trying to instil(灌输) good habits? As early as possible before the age of seven, research suggests.
zh: 本段完成全文收束，重申父母是最重要的影响者，并给出明确时间要求：before seven。它将研究、家庭实践、游戏工具和学校教育最终统一到“尽早培养良好金钱习惯”的文章主旨。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: On a warm October morning, Daniel Agok woke up to another disappointing day at his school in Wanyjok, South Sudan. The classes he had planned teaching computer skills to aspiring young professionals were canceled, due to an unreliable diesel generator and the absence of a municipal power grid in his area. Now, he would be losing frustrated customers as well as income. Agok is just one of the hundreds of millions of people in sub-Saharan Africa, many of whom are business owners, who still do not have dependable electricity. This inequitable access to energy continues to put their livelihood and future at risk.
zh: 本段承担 problem introduction 的功能，用一个可感知的个体故事建立读者对能源短缺的认识。它为文章主旨中的 rapidly expand access to clean, reliable, and affordable electricity 提供了首要的现实依据。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: The current system keeps a lid on the economic talents of people like Agok and his students. We must instead unleash their abilities and let Africa reach its true economic potential. That means wiring Africa with clean, dependable energy.
zh: 本段把第一段的生活困境上升为经济潜能被压制的问题，并首次鲜明提出 clean, dependable energy 的政策方向。它直接呼应文章主旨中 unlock the continent's economic potential 的目标。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Historically, national governments on the continent have led electrification efforts, but fewer than half of the people surveyed say that the national grid is providing a reliable supply of electricity.
zh: 本段指出传统政府主导模式的 reliability 缺口，构成全文主张私营部门参与的反面论据。它使后文的 private-sector partnership 不再只是备选方案，而成为有现实必要性的选择。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: This has led to expensive and harmful temporary "solutions". In Nigeria alone experts estimate people spend $13 billion every year on fuel for toxic, polluting generators. That number will only grow as the continent's population hits 2.5 billion people by 2050. Deploying modern grid infrastructure with speed and at scale is essential to replacing these temporary solutions with reliable and affordable alternatives.
zh: 本段把不可靠供电的后果具体化为污染、健康风险和巨额成本，并用人口增长放大紧迫性。它进一步支撑文章主旨中 replace polluting generators 以及 large-scale electrification 的必要性。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: The rapidly growing private power sector in Africa holds the key to achieving the speed and scale necessary to close the continent's energy access gap. Private companies today are building world-class infrastructure and driving forward economic growth with sustainable business models. In fact, many governments agree and have begun to embrace the private sector as partners in providing reliable power at scale. In South Africa, President Cyril Ramaphosa has streamlined licensing requirements and enlisted the private sector to play a key role.
zh: 这是全文的核心论证段，正面回答“谁能够推动能源普及”。它直接承载文章主旨中 private sector can lead large-scale electrification 和 partnering with governments 两项关键主张。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: South Africa is just one example. Across the continent, the private sector has delivered power faster and more reliably, and governments are increasingly turning to private partners.
zh: 本段扩大第五段南非案例的代表性，表明 private-sector participation 已是跨区域趋势。它增强了文章主旨的普遍适用性，避免论证仅依赖一个国家的有限经验。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: With the right funding and structure in place, the private sector will come together to provide this essential service. After all, electrifying sub-Saharan Africa is a $350 billion opportunity.
zh: 本段补足第五、六段方案的实施条件，说明私营部门参与需要 funding and structure 的配套。它直接对应文章主旨中的 receiving appropriate funding and support，使主张更具可操作性。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Today, Daniel Agok is steadily growing his business in South Sudan. His town of Wanyjok was electrified by a private company, providing clean, reliable, and affordable power to his business and his neighbors. Agok now operates his growing computer skills training business smoothly. His classes are no longer affected by the smell and the constant noise of the diesel generator, and he saves money with more affordable power. His students are developing hardware and software skills.
zh: 本段回到 Agok，形成从“停电受害者”到“受益经营者”的闭环叙事。它以 Wanyjok 的可见成果验证全文主张：政府支持和私营参与能够提供 clean, reliable, affordable electricity，并释放当地经济潜力。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Three artists have brought a lawsuit against Stability AI, DeviantArt, and Midjourney, alleging that the text-to-image AI tools have infringed the rights of thousands of artists.
zh: 本段是全文的 news hook，它先提出艺术家与生成式 AI 公司之间的法律冲突，为后文解释侵权依据、艺术家担忧和 fair use 抗辩奠定中心议题。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: The lawsuit claims that the Stable Diffusion tool used by Stability AI, DeviantArt, and Midjourney was trained on billions of copyrighted images downloaded from the internet and used by the companies "without compensation or consent from the artists."
zh: 本段回答了“为什么要起诉”这个核心问题，它把文章主旨中的 unlawful use 具体化，并为后文有关赔偿、职业威胁和 fair use 的争论提供事实起点。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: The artists are represented by The Joseph Saveri Law Firm and Matthew Butterick.
zh: 本段补足诉讼行动的法律执行者，使首段的起诉事件更完整；它也自然衔接下段 law firm 的公开表态，说明引语来自哪一方。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: "If Stable Diffusion and similar products are allowed to continue to operate as they do now, the foreseeable result is they will replace the very artists whose stolen works power these AI products with whom they are competing," the law firm wrote in a press release. "AI image products are not just an infringement of artists' rights; they will eliminate 'artist' as a viable career path. In addition to obtaining compensation for the wrongful conduct, this lawsuit seeks to prevent that outcome and ensure these products follow the same rules as any other new technology that involves the use of massive amounts of intellectual property. If streaming music can be accomplished within the law, so can AI products."
zh: 本段深化文章主旨中的 future of artistic careers，它呈现原告方最完整的价值判断与诉讼目标，也使版权争议延伸为技术发展与劳动价值之间的冲突。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Since text-to-image generators have increased in popularity in the past year, many artists have been vocalizing their opposition to AI art after seeing their own distorted signatures appear in AI art and finding out that their work was used to train the tools without their permission.
zh: 本段从法庭上的 lawsuit 转向更广泛的艺术家群体，说明该案并非孤立事件，而是生成式 AI 普及后长期积累的版权不满的集中体现。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Not only are many artists furious at the possible copyright violations of AI art, but they have also been frustrated by how AI tools are able to sidestep the labor and art processes they are required to go through. As a result, many artists have been trying to ban AI art from art-sharing platforms.
zh: 本段进一步展示版权争议对现实平台生态的影响，它补充了文章中 artists 的利益受损不仅是法律问题，也是有关创作过程、公平竞争和社区规则的问题。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: As AI innovation continues at a rapid speed, it seems that artists and lawmakers are trying to put a brake on further developments before it's too late.
zh: 本段把文章的冲突由个人权利和平台管理提升到法律政策层面，直接呼应文章主旨中的未来风险，并为下文另一方的 fair use 观点制造对照。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Many tech enthusiasts are still rallying around the promise of AI tools to create detailed images cheaply and quickly—anonymous tech supporters have already published a response to Butterick and Joseph Saveri's lawsuit on a website, using the "fair use" clause as the basis for why copyrighted images could be used by the tool.
zh: 本段提供与艺术家和律师相对的技术支持者立场，使报道保持多方 voices；它也将文章的争论集中到 fair use 这一决定版权争议走向的关键法律概念。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示

en: Fair use, a legal doctrine that allows for a limited usage of copyrighted materials without permission by the original creators for purposes such as teaching and news sharing, is what a lot of generative model creators claim that their training data is covered by. However, since fair use applies differently to each case, it's hard to make a blanket statement about all works in a dataset as being applicable.
zh: 本段以较为平衡的法律说明收束全文：它承认 AI 公司可提出 fair use 抗辩，同时强调该抗辩并非普遍有效，从而保留了诉讼结果和版权边界的不确定性。
note_type: 原句所在段的理解提示
